configuration.split_policy: all unordered two-copy spoke partitions with each load at least 2; unequal loads ranked first
configuration.anchor_sets: all subsets of size 1..3 of non-hub top-quartile/high-degree parent vertices

operation_definition.replacement_rule: replace each Q1 degree-11 hub by two copies on its own bipartition side; every former spoke is assigned exactly once and each copy gets at least two spokes
operation_definition.repair_rule: for a deterministic subset of remaining high-degree vertices, attach an internally disjoint parity-correct bipartite ear from alternating split copies; optionally add one shared opposite-side relay for each same-side anchor pair
operation_definition.learned_failure_basis: prior Q1 synchronized splits were colorable; obstruction analysis ranks high best weighted-hub margin, tight span lower bound, and high degree variance, while advising asymmetric loads and avoiding isolated symmetric relays
static_ranking_features: sum of degree-forced colors at remaining high-degree vertices
margin tier from learned thresholds -1.5 and -2.5
operation_definition.solver_derived_ranking_feature: bounded rank_potential_solve CP-SAT probes after deleting each new gadget edge; record which deletions restore colorability
operation_definition.classification: exact rank_potential_solve CP-SAT for each selected unique candidate, limited to at most 5 seconds and 4 workers
operation_definition.negative_confirmation: fixed_span_sat_solve independently over every legal span from delta through n-1; only all-INFEASIBLE evidence counts
operation_definition.timeout_policy: a primary or independent UNKNOWN is unresolved, counted once as timeout, and never counted as non-colorable
operation_definition.graph_serialization_policy: full graph JSON appears only inside confirmed_negatives
